text.p: National Surgery Centers Inc said Wednesday it acquired Southwest Surgical Center in Bakersfield, Calif.
This multi-specialty center, which was acquired from a group of physicians, is the company's second center in this market. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

National Surgery said Southwest Surgical Center's case mix is primarily orthopedic and podiatric related. This complements its other center in the Bakersfield market, which has a case mix more heavily weighted toward ophthalmic procedures.

National Surgery said it expects the new center will annual net revenue of approximately $2.5 million. In 1996, National Surgery Centers reported total case volume of 84,970 cases and net revenue of $77.4 million.
National Surgery Centers has a network of 33 outpatient centers located in 12 states.
